home.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
home.faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about pricing and upgrade options
home.faq.q1.question: Can I upgrade later?
home.faq.q1.answer: Yes – upgrades are flexible on two axes. You can switch to a higher plan (e.g. Sprachkurs → Sprachkurs + AI Pro) and/or to a longer duration (e.g. 3 → 12 months) at any time. You only pay the price difference between your current bundle and the new one. Your progress, XP and vocabulary stay intact, and the upgrade activates immediately.
home.faq.q1.point1: • Upgrade your plan, your duration, or both
home.faq.q1.point2: • You pay only the price difference – never the full new price
home.faq.q1.point4: • All progress, XP, badges and vocabulary preserved
home.faq.q2.question: Can I downgrade to a shorter plan?
home.faq.q2.answer: No, downgrades are not available. Once you purchase a plan, you have access for the full duration. However, you can always learn at your own pace—there's no requirement to finish within the time frame. If you complete the course early, you'll still have access until your plan expires, giving you time to review and practice.
home.faq.q2.reason2: • Full course access from day one
home.faq.q2.reason3: • Flexible learning pace within your timeframe
home.faq.q3.question: What if I don't finish within my chosen duration?
home.faq.q3.answer: No problem. If you need more time, upgrade to a longer duration within the same plan and pay only the price difference. After expiry you can also repurchase any bundle – your progress, XP and vocabulary are saved permanently and reattach automatically.
home.faq.q3.option1: • Extend duration: upgrade from e.g. 3 → 12 months, pay only the difference
home.faq.q3.option2: • Repurchase: buy any plan again at full price after expiry
home.faq.q3.option3: • Progress preserved: XP, badges and vocabulary stay saved forever
home.faq.q4.question: Is this a subscription or one-time payment?
home.faq.q4.answer: It's a one-time payment. You pay once and get full access to all {{moduleCount}} modules ({{unitCount}} units) for your chosen duration (3, 6 or 12 months). There are no recurring charges, no hidden fees, and no automatic renewals. After your access period ends, you can choose to repurchase if you want to continue learning.
home.faq.q4.answerWaitlist: It's a one-time payment. You pay once and get full course access for your chosen duration (3, 6 or 12 months). There are no recurring charges, no hidden fees, and no automatic renewals. After your access period ends, you can choose to repurchase if you want to continue learning.
home.faq.q5.question: Do all plans include the same features?
home.faq.q5.answer: No – and that's intentional. The four plans (Sprachkurs, AI Chat Standalone, Sprachkurs + AI, Sprachkurs + AI Pro) differ deliberately in what's included. Pick the bundle that fits how you want to learn:
home.faq.q5.item1: Sprachkurs: all course content (modules, units, vocabulary, exercises) – no AI Buddy
home.faq.q5.item1Waitlist: Sprachkurs: all course content (modules, units, vocabulary, exercises) – no AI Buddy
home.faq.q5.item2: AI Chat Standalone: AI Buddy + chat attachments + Knowledge Base – no course
home.faq.q5.item2Waitlist: AI Chat Standalone: AI Buddy + chat attachments + Knowledge Base – no course
home.faq.q5.item3: Sprachkurs + AI: course + context-linked AI Buddy + chat attachments (photos & files in chat) – no Knowledge Base
home.faq.q5.item4: Sprachkurs + AI Pro: everything – course, AI Buddy, Knowledge Base, larger AI Energy quota, community
home.faq.q5.item5: Within the same plan, only the duration (3, 6 or 12 months) varies – features are identical
home.faq.q5.item6: Top up AI Energy anytime (available for Standalone, Sprachkurs + AI and Pro)
home.faq.q5.note: See the feature comparison table above for the full side-by-side breakdown.
home.faq.q6.question: Can I get a refund?
home.faq.q6.answer: I offer a 14-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied within the first 14 days, contact me for a full refund—no questions asked. After 14 days, refunds are not available.
home.faq.q6.rule1: • Full refund within 14 days of purchase
home.faq.q7.question: What happens after my plan expires?
home.faq.q7.answer: After your plan expires, you'll lose access to the course content, but your progress is saved permanently. If you repurchase any plan later, you'll pick up exactly where you left off—all completed units, XP, badges, and vocabulary progress will be restored.
home.faq.q8.question: Which plan is right for me?
home.faq.q8.intro: Pick the bundle that matches what you actually need – course content, AI Buddy, or both. The duration (3, 6 or 12 months) is then a question of how much time you want to give yourself.
home.faq.q8.course.title: Sprachkurs – course only
home.faq.q8.course.desc: The full Serbian course (all modules, units & vocabulary) without the AI Buddy. Best if you mainly want structured learning content and don't need an AI conversation partner.
home.faq.q8.standalone.title: AI Chat Standalone – AI Buddy only
home.faq.q8.standalone.desc: Full AI Buddy access (incl. chat attachments and Knowledge Base), but no course content. Best if you already speak some Serbian and want a smart conversation partner for everyday life, travel and culture.
home.faq.q8.course_ai.title: Sprachkurs + AI – course + AI starter
home.faq.q8.course_ai.desc: The full course PLUS a context-linked AI Buddy: it knows your current unit and vocabulary — with chat attachments for photos and files in the conversation. Great for guided learning with an AI that picks up where the lesson stops.
home.faq.q8.course_ai_pro.title: Sprachkurs + AI Pro – everything
home.faq.q8.course_ai_pro.desc: All of it: course, AI Buddy with Knowledge Base (persistent document library), highest monthly energy quota and community access. Best for daily learners who want zero limits.
home.faq.q8.note: Not sure? Start with Sprachkurs + AI – it covers most learners including chat attachments. If you later want a persistent Knowledge Base, more energy and community, upgrade to Sprachkurs + AI Pro and only pay the difference.

admin.contentStudio.brief.field.unitType: standard = new words and one grammar target; review/checkpoint = recap only; exam = simulation.
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.cefrLeve: Controls sentence length, terminology and exercise difficulty.

admin.contentStudio.brief.field.situatio: Where, who, what happens. One paragraph. Optionally end with 'Suggested key vocabulary (max 30): ...'.
Arrival day in Belgrade. The learner lands at the airport and checks into a hotel ...
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.canDo.he: 4-6 statements, one per line, e.g. 'A1.1-SOC-01: Can greet, say goodbye ...'. They become the Learning Objectives.
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.canDo.pl: A1.1-SOC-01: Can greet, say goodbye and use basic politeness formulas ...
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.grammarI: Exactly one primary grammar point with the exact forms to teach.
The verb biti in 1st and 2nd person singular: ja sam, ti si, plus negation nisam, nisi ...
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.grammarO: What must NOT be introduced yet (and in which unit it comes).
biti in 3rd person and plural (Unit 7); noun cases; the particle li (Unit 2) ...
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.chunks.h: Fixed phrases the unit may use without explaining their grammar, with 'preview in Unit N' where known.
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.chunks.p: "Zovem se ..." (My name is), "Drago mi je" (Nice to meet you), "u Beogradu" (locative preview in Unit 19) ...
Grammar and key vocabulary from earlier units to reuse. 'none' for the first unit.
biti (sam/si) from Unit 1; greetings; hvala, molim ...
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.pitfalls: 2-3 typical mistakes, one per line, as WRONG -> CORRECT with a short reason. Feeds the 'Watch Out' block.
Putting the short verb form first: WRONG "Sam Ana." -> CORRECT "Ja sam Ana."
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.scenes.h: 2-3 one-line scene descriptions, one per line.
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.scenes.p: Passport control: official greets, asks for the passport ...
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.listenin: 3-5 words or minimal pairs the learner should listen to and repeat (text-to-speech).
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.cultural: One line; the Creator writes 4-6 neutral sentences about it.
Greetings by time of day; handshake and eye contact when introducing yourself
admin.contentStudio.brief.field.exercise: Which exercise categories carry the grammar target; what the others test.
Exercise 2 and 3 test sam/si/nisam/nisi; Exercise 1 greetings; Exercise 4 key nouns; Exercise 5 the dialogue scenes.
